ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (near-black) across ~95% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/tan) pixel clusters localized at distal tips and within scattered circular rings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark base layer; high-contrast geometric clusters (tan/white) at far left and right coordinates; scattered high-contrast circular rings (rosettes) distributed primarily in the upper-mid region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 42 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 0.15 relative to the visible fluke vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration map with pixel-amplitude variations between 5-20 pixels; irregular peak/valley intervals across the entire boundary from median notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve fitted to the trailing edge boundary of both lobes, transitioning to a convex curve at the outermost distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular ring clusters (radii 5-12 pixels) detected across the central ventral surface; most prominent on the left lobe and upper-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, thin, low-width linear pixel disruptions (high-intensity white) visible on the upper right lobe and near the center-left ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-relief, high-intensity tan/white barnacle clusters colonized on both distal tips; significant circular scarring (depigmentation rings) from detached parasites.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-density colonization of acorn barnacles creating an irregular, jagged profile at the extreme lateral edges.
